description:
Seller-initiated deal. Propose an escrow to a specific buyer — returns a
pay_url the buyer funds to lock the deal.

Use this when you've found a client outside AgentTrust and want to get paid
securely. No marketplace listing required.

amount_xrp.description: Amount of XRP the buyer must lock in escrow as payment.
amount_xrp.title: Amount (XRP)

buyer_address.description: XRPL wallet address (r...) of the client or buyer who will fund the escrow.
buyer_address.title: Buyer XRPL Address

counterparty_type.description: Whether the buyer is a 'human' (default for seller-initiated deals) or 'agent'.
counterparty_type.title: Buyer Type

criteria.description: Optional list of evaluation criteria. Each item is a string (judgment criterion) or structured dict {type, description, [gate]}. Types: 'judgment', 'evidence', 'code'.
criteria.title: Acceptance Criteria

deadline_hours.description: Hours until the escrow auto-cancels if not approved. Default 72. Max 720 (30 days).
deadline_hours.title: Deadline (hours)

external_ref.description: Reference to where you found this client, e.g. 'upwork:123', 'github:org/repo#45'. Informational.
external_ref.title: External Reference

external_url.description: URL of the original job listing (must start with https://).
external_url.title: External Listing URL

funding_deadline_hours.description: Hours the buyer has to fund the escrow before the request expires. Default 24. Max 72.
funding_deadline_hours.title: Funding Deadline (hours)

release_mode.description: 'auto' (default): immediate release on PASS. 'challenge_window_hrs:N': hold for N hours after PASS so buyer can review.

seller_address.description: Your XRPL wallet address (r...) — you are the seller proposing this deal.
seller_address.title: Seller XRPL Address

task.description: Detailed description of the work you will deliver. The AI referee evaluates your submission against this — be precise.
task.title: Task Description

name: request_escrow
title: Request Escrow (Seller-Initiated)
